WITH status_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.healtheval,
        COUNT(*) as cnt,
        COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as share_pct
    FROM scanconservation sc
    JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        AVG(share_pct) OVER () as avg_share
    FROM status_stats
),
above_avg AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_avg
    WHERE share_pct > avg_share
)
SELECT
    AVG(cnt) as avg_count,
    AVG(share_pct) as avg_share,
    AVG(share_pct - avg_share) as avg_exceed
FROM above_avg
